sources.text: Today will be a day of nostalgia as all your good memories bring a smile to your face. You might encounter a few problems that will drive you to the edge of the cliff. Do not delay pending conversations with your better half and bring affection to the table when you do so, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Today you should be feeling especially warm and loving toward close friends and children, Taurus. You could also especially appreciate the arts. You might attend a play or concert or decide to try your hand at one of the fine arts yourself. In the evening, go out and enjoy your friends' company, if possible. Celebrate just being together in whatever way you can!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Feelings intensify to reveal your deepest desires. However, it's important to recognize how power dynamics play into your connections while brooding Pluto activates midafternoon. Practice self-care to balance unruly emotions when Mars grows restless just before midnight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Smile as it is best antidote for all your problems. If you work or study by staying away from home, then learn to stay away from such people who waste your money and time. Your extravagant lifestyle could cause tensions at home so avoid late nights and spending too much on others. Be alert as chances of losing friendship are high on card today. Finishing your work on time and going home early will prove to be good for you today. It will also bring happiness to your family and you will also feel refreshed. Things might go out of your control in your married life today. You might plan to visit a close relative along with your family, and it certainly is a good day for that. However, avoid talking about any bad past incident, as it may create an unpleasant situation.

readings.text: There may be fewer tasks in your hands when the day begins but Ganesha advises you to gear up as more activities will be on your agenda in the later part of the day. Your mailbox might get filled with e-mails from your clients and you might be busy to do follow ups.

You will feel a strong connection to the people around you and this will pave the way for better relations in the workplace overall. Communication is strong and you will find that the more you talk, the more bonded you will feel to those around you.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that today you will be very practical in your approach towards money matters. You will not feel bad while telling others that you are practicing economy.

You may need to reconsider recent financial plans. Your head is full of all kinds of amazingly creative ideas. If you're a writer, journalist, or publisher, this is a great time to be you. But you need to use these gifts in a responsible way. Make sure you're saving your money with a reliable company.

readings.text: Today you will have to plan activities very smartly. You will have to gear up your day by lining up things that are on your priority list. While you are in good health, it will be possible for you to address many things at once.

Make what you do count by cutting back on processed sugar and other dietary "no-no's." The energy that you have to work with feels a bit thin with the planetary alignment today. You react on a high plane to the stirring force of these transits and may feel psychologically exhausted. So much is going on in your unconscious and there is never enough time to focus. Be sure to get plenty of rest and to eat a strictly conservative diet based on fresh produce.

lucky.remedy: For a smooth-sailing love life, donate a coconut and seven almonds at any religious place.
